scenes.title: Hook: the whole planet
scenes.purpose: [hook-specimen] The specimen whole, with a scale bar from frame 1.
scenes.why: Sets the object and its scale.
on_screen_text: 6,371 km from your feet to the centre
scenes.visual: Earth disc with land; scale bar from frame 0; radius draws; land turns slowly.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.

transition_out.continuity: One continuous surface; the camera and the object's state carry the change.

scenes.title: Cutaway: four layers
scenes.purpose: [cutaway] Open the object: a quadrant cut with labelled layers.
scenes.why: Names the four parts the film reuses.
scenes.visual: A quadrant opens; four labels with leaders into the cut.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.

transition_out.continuity: One continuous surface; the camera and the object's state carry the change.

scenes.title: Scale ladder: the crust at 60x
scenes.purpose: [scale-ladder] Zoom 60x with the scale bar re-labelled.
scenes.why: Shows how thin the crust is at true scale.
on_screen_text: At true scale, the crust is a thin skin
scenes.visual: Whole cross-section opens; push 60x into the surface; bar becomes 50 km; crust and borehole notes.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.

transition_out.continuity: One continuous surface; the camera and the object's state carry the change.

scenes.title: Process: the flowing core
scenes.purpose: [process] One process with direction: the outer core flows; the field draws.
on_screen_text: Flowing liquid iron makes the magnetic field
scenes.visual: Pull back to 1x; particles circulate in the outer core; dipole field lines draw.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.

transition_out.continuity: One continuous surface; the camera and the object's state carry the change.

scenes.title: Close: the whole specimen
scenes.purpose: [close] Back to the whole specimen at the starting scale, with the finding.
on_screen_text: Our deepest hole: 0.2% of the way down
scenes.visual: Cut closes; field dims; finding; radius draws again; specimen breathes.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.
